{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders (revenue == 999999.99)
completed_non_test = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_non_test['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
